messages:
PagerDuty: INC-20260317-001 triggered for service=inference-prod region=prod-east-1 — GPU OOM spike during prefill. Paging oncall. <https://pagerduty.example/INC-20260317-001>

Sophia L.: Pager going off for repeated OOMs during prefill. Seeing container restarts in prod-east-1 around 20:03 UTC. @Jordan (oncall) can you take?

PagerDuty: Incident assigned to Jordan (oncall) — acknowledgement requested.

Jordan (oncall): Acknowledged, looking now. Joining call in 2.

Mike R.: Observed ~28% 5xx on /v1/generate for model=rwu-13b-large-started at ~20:02 UTC. Logs show repeated CUDA OOM followed by container restart loop.

Mike R.: Logs snippet:
```
kubectl logs -n inference pod/prefill-abc-123 | tail -n 40
...
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 5.00 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total capacity; 33.50 GiB already allocated; 2.75 GiB free; 4.00 GiB reserved in total by PyTorch)
INFO:root:Restarting container due to OOM
```

Mike R.: dmesg on node shows "OOM-killer invoked" and "kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 17234 (python)" — likely fragmentation + very large prefill sequences.

Customer Success - Priya: Got a report from customer ACME that some long prompts are returning 5xx or timing out. They're seeing higher latency for chat-heavy flows.

Jordan (oncall): Immediate mitigations applied:
- throttled long-context prefill requests above 12k tokens with 429 for public API via rate-limiter rule rl-prefill-long
- moved traffic from pool prefill-east to backup pool prefill-east-burst
- restarted 2 unstable pods after confirming kernel freed GPU memory

Jordan (oncall): Commands I ran:
```
# cordon the flappy node
kubectl cordon gpu-prod-12
# scale down prefill concurrency
rctl pools update prefill-east --concurrency 0.6
# set fallback model
redwood route update /v1/generate --fallback-model rwu-13b-quant
```

Ophelia: Noted. I'm enabling temporary KV cache trimming for long-prefill to reduce memory pressure, and adding a rule to reject prefetch requests >32k tokens at the gateway.

InfraBot: Autoscaler attempted surge but hit project GPU quota, created ticket Q-9876 to quota team.

Sophia L.: Quick customer update draft: "We experienced GPU memory pressure from very long prefill requests which caused a subset of containers to restart and increased error rates. We throttled long requests, shifted traffic to backup capacity, and restarted affected pods. We are monitoring; a follow-up report will be provided in 2 hours." Thoughts?

Mike R.: OOM rate dropped from ~8/min to ~0.4/min after throttling and fallback. Two pods still show restart churn but stable since last restart 12m ago.

Jordan (oncall): Long-term root cause note: signs of GPU memory fragmentation from many repeated long-sequence prefetches + large KV cache retention. Recommend enforce max_prefetch_tokens, stronger cache compaction, and evaluate per-request prefetch limits in runtime.

Jordan (oncall): Handing off active watch to Ophelia in 30m. Documenting runbook steps taken and current thresholds in the incident board.

Ophelia: Acknowledged takeover. I'll keep the node cordoned and ensure <2 restarts/hr threshold or re-escalate. I'll post hourly updates and coordinate with quota team for burst capacity.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260317-001 acknowledged by Ophelia. Oncall owner updated.

Sophia L.: Thanks everyone. I'll send the customer note now and schedule a post-incident triage tomorrow for fragmentation and prefetch limits.

Jordan (oncall): Final note — if OOMs resume, we should immediately enforce model fallback to quantized variants and enable aggressive KV eviction; don't run any model rollouts on prefill pools until cleared.

Customer Success - Priya: Customer updated and appreciative of rapid response. They asked for estimated timeline for permanent fix (we said we'll follow up after triage). :thumbsup:
